concerns.text: FR-003 mandates retaining 'at most the [deferred] genes with highest variance,' leaving the gene-count threshold undefined and unmeasurable, which prevents creating a concrete task to implement filtering or verify output size.

The Assumptions section claims power analysis shows '≥ 80% power' for detecting r ≥ 0.80 but cites a '[deferred]' value for the lower threshold (0.75), creating a logical gap where the spec relies on an undefined statistical justification to permit the 0.75 minimum threshold required by FR-004.

Tasks T129, T130, T131, and T137 introduce a 'BioGRID' external validation set and 'calibration' routine to select thresholds, which constitutes significant scope creep as the spec (FR-006, FR-023) explicitly limits evaluation to STRING high-confidence interactions and internal sensitivity analysis without mentioning BioGRID or external calibration.

The plan states the pipeline will 'optionally filter edges by orthogonal subcellular colocalization evidence,' a feature absent from the spec's functional requirements (FR-001 through FR-045), creating an untraceable implementation step that violates scope.

Multiple tasks (T131, T137, T138) describe downloading and using a BioGRID validation set to 'calibrate' the correlation threshold, directly contradicting FR-023 which defines sensitivity analysis as looping over fixed thresholds (0.75–0.90), not training on external data.

FR-023 requires a sensitivity analysis recording metrics for thresholds 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, and 0.90 to select the optimal one, but T085 and T137 propose a 'calibration routine' using an external validation set (BioGRID) to maximize F1, changing the method from internal sensitivity check to external training.

The plan mentions an 'optional orthogonal filter' for subcellular colocalization (UniProt) to add construct validity, whereas FR-026 strictly defines the justification as literature citation and sensitivity analysis; filtering is outside scope.

Tasks T141–T143 introduce a 'Dyson False-Positive Estimate' section and Poisson calculator based on reviewer feedback, but the spec (FR-026) only requires a construct validity justification citing literature; this is scope creep.
The plan's Phase 6 mentions a 'verification script,' but the spec’s FR-017 requires it to run *after each Make target*; tasks don't explicitly map this trigger to Makefile implementation.
Task T012 implements a CLI validator for `--threshold ≥ 0.75`, but the spec (FR-004) also mandates a *default* of 0.80; tasks don't explicitly include verifying this default value.
